$comment: AHU-6401 air handling unit twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the Swegon and Passive House data and fan, heat recovery and coil balances; the unit sends only what it measures.

identification.model: GOLD RX 20 (rotary heat exchanger, IQlogic controls)
identification.description: Office floor air handling unit: rotary heat recovery, ePM1 bag filters, duct heating and cooling coils, EC fans, CO2-controlled, BACnet/IP
identification.unit: Swegon GOLD RX size 20, indoor, rotary heat exchanger, supply and extract fans GOLD Wing+ with IE5 EC/PM motors
identification.filters: Glass-fibre bag filters: supply ePM1, extract ePM10 (ISO 16890 classes, assumption of the selected options)
identification.coils: Low-temperature hot water heating coil and chilled water cooling coil in the supply duct, each with a two-way valve and a heat meter
identification.controls: Swegon IQlogic, BACnet/IP to the building management system; supply airflow from the extract air CO2 (DCV)
identification.service: Mechanical ventilation of one open-plan office floor, about 100 workplaces

unit.source: Swegon GOLD RX product page: size 20 airflow 0.3 to 1.8 m3/s (Ecodesign). Swegon GOLD RX sizing catalogue 2025-02-21: motor shaft power per fan 2.4 kW (alt. 3.4 kW) for size 020. Passive House Institute component database, GOLD F RX STE Aluminium 20: airflow 2520 to 4500 m3/h, specific electric power 0.44 Wh/m3, heat recovery rate 83 %.

airflow.source: Design airflow 1.0 m3/s (3600 m3/h, inside the PHI certified range and the size 20 range), DCV minimum 0.45 and maximum 1.2 m3/s: assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. Air density and heat capacity: textbook values at about 20 C.

fans.source: Total pressure rise per fan at design with clean filters (filter, wheel, casing, coils and ducts) and total fan efficiency (impeller, EC/PM motor and drive): assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. Together they give SFP = (520 + 460) / 0.62 = 1.58 kW/(m3/s) for both fans, the same as the PHI certified 0.44 Wh/m3 x 3.6 = 1.58 kW/(m3/s). On the fixed duct system the pressure outside the filter rises with flow squared (fan affinity laws); the efficiency is taken constant over the DCV range (assumption).

filters.source: ISO 16890 classes of the selected glass-fibre bag filters, initial pressure drop at design flow, and the exponent of the pressure drop against flow (between 1 for laminar and 2 for turbulent flow through the media): assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. The GOLD filter holder is rated for ePM1 85 % bypass leakage (Swegon product page).

heat_recovery.source: Design supply temperature ratio at balanced design flow 0.83, taken from the PHI certified heat recovery rate of 83 % (the PHI rate is an effective rate measured by PHI's own method, a conservative stand-in for the EN 308 dry temperature ratio). Change of the ratio with flow (-0.08 per 100 % of design flow, more contact time at low flow) and its cap: assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. With unequal flows the supply-side ratio is scaled by extract / supply flow when the extract flow is smaller.

coils.source: Heating and cooling coil capacities at full valve opening and the supply air setpoint: assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. The valve position is taken proportional to the duty (assumption: equal-percentage valve on a coil gives a near-linear duty against position). The supply fan motor sits in the air stream: all its electric power ends up as heat in the supply air.

ventilation.source: Design occupancy, peak occupancy, outdoor CO2, DCV CO2 setpoint, design outdoor air per person and room temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data. CO2 generation 0.0052 l/s per sedentary adult: a commonly quoted value (assumption); Persily and de Jonge (2017) give rates by age, sex and activity, replace it with theirs. Steady-state CO2 balance: CO2_room = CO2_out + G x N / Q.

economics.source: Electricity and heat prices, operating hours, cost of one set of supply bag filters with labour, the rate at which the supply filter pressure drop rises at design flow, and the heating season: assumption: typical value, replace with your AHU Design selection printout / site data.

weather.source: Demo weather: a winter day, 0 C mean with a 4 K daily swing (warmest at 15:00). Assumption for the stand-in only.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock is the visitor's local time (office hours fill the floor, nights run at the DCV minimum); faults ramp in over minutes, where real filters load over months.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

filter_loading.name: Supply filter loading (dust)
filter_loading.symptoms: supply filter pressure drop above clean at today's flow; fan power and SFP up

filter_bypass.name: Torn or badly seated supply filter (bypass)
filter_bypass.symptoms: supply filter pressure drop far below clean at today's flow: unfiltered air bypasses

fan_degradation.name: Supply fan degradation (dirty impeller, EC motor or drive)
fan_degradation.symptoms: supply fan power above expected for its flow and pressure; SFP up with normal filters

wheel_slip.name: Rotor drive belt slipping or broken
wheel_slip.symptoms: temperature ratio of the wheel far below expected with the rotor commanded to full speed; heating coil works harder

heating_valve_passing.name: Heating valve passing (does not close)
heating_valve_passing.symptoms: heat meter shows heat with the valve closed; the cooling coil opens to take it away again

supply_temp_drift.name: Supply air temperature sensor drift
supply_temp_drift.symptoms: the coil heat balance from the air temperatures disagrees with the heat meters

co2_sensor_drift.name: CO2 sensor drifting low
co2_sensor_drift.symptoms: occupancy implied by CO2 below the people count; DCV cuts the airflow, outdoor air per person falls

extract_blockage.name: Extract duct blocked (fire damper closed, grilles covered)
extract_blockage.symptoms: extract airflow well below supply; extract fan works against a higher pressure
